target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Hays — project Master Plant Pool has a wild observation and Hays-local flag for S. radula. Williamson — dedicated county treatment documents S. radula. Kerr — Kerr WMA vascular-flora publication explicitly lists S. radula in Edwards Plateau vegetation.

morphology.look_here_first: Start with texture and leaf arrangement. Roughstem rosinweed is a perennial with very rough, sandpapery leaves and stems, broad sessile leaves, and yellow sunflower-like heads. Use the coarse scabrous surface plus stem-leaf arrangement and peduncle length to separate it from nearby Silphium concepts.
diagnostic_traits: leaves may be opposite below and alternate above
heads relatively close to leafy upper stems compared with longer-peduncled relatives

comparisons.key_distinctions: Compared with S. laciniatum, leaves are broad rather than deeply pinnatifid. Compared with S. integrifolium sensu stricto, S. radula is typically rougher/hairier and may show mixed opposite/alternate leaf arrangement.
